notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only detailed source is a 1972 National Geodetic Survey description reprinted on the Forest Lookouts Bronson page. It gives the structure, paint, cab, about 110 ft height and location, but no build date, staffing, fire history or current access. The height is converted from the 110 ft figure in the description (33.5 m). The road directions in that 1972 description appear in the story only as a caveat: they may be out of date and are not a current access source. A Visit Sabine County Facebook post appeared in search with a claim that the tower was most likely erected in the early 1940s by the Texas A&M Forest Service, on former Kirby Lumber Company land. The page text was not readable (the fetch returned only the title), so the claim is not used and is a lead for a human to check against Texas Forest Service records or Kirby Lumber archives. The record's agency value ', Texas Forest Service' is corrected in corrections. No photos added.
